_doc: RimFlow v3.0 Dispatcher schedule (design/RimMandrake/rimflow_v3_2026-10-26.md §3: one schedule file runs every role). Read by src/RimMandrake/rimflow/dispatcher.py. Times in seconds. The owner sets this file; an enabled role with launch keys (instructions, seat, clone, model, ledger_item) is run by role_launch.py; every role stays enabled false until the owner switches it on.
_token_notes_item_doc: review U N2: a dispatcher note holding a token term (ops_watch_rules.json token_talk.terms) bound for an item a token-blind role reads (any role ledger_item but a token_aware role's) goes here instead; Operations has its own ledger_item so its launch, done and cap notes never reach the shared table. The Producer still reads Operations' REPLAN REQUEST notes on its own ledger_item (operations.md: plan terms only, no numbers).

BENCH._why: BENCH is the owner's workshop window (the Conductor's session mode): watched, never woken or resumed by a program

measure.name: ops_watch
measure._why: the Dispatcher measures deterministically, Operations analyses (owner 2026-10-27, ledger OWNER 05:59:41Z: Operations "should just have those things automatically gathered for it, so it's not constantly burning tokens gathering it all up for every question considered"). A systemd user timer runs it, not dispatcher.py; listed here so the one schedule file names everything that runs.

roles.name: Conductor
roles.trigger: his message; his presence (session); quick checks
roles._caps_why: measured run floor 35-53k tokens (role_launch_2026-10-27/proof/RESULT.md): quick 80,000 = floor + headroom; daily 300,000 = two quick runs + one session; the shrunk caps stay >= 60,000 (80,000 x 0.75) or the band launches nothing
roles.off_switch: enabled false here, or the file D:\ClaudeWork\rimmandrake\conductor\CONDUCTOR_OFF
roles._why: never paused by throttle_order (v3 §3); its helpers shrink first (sim finding 7). role_launch.py runs quick_checks_local; band slots per conductor.md (AMBER/RED: the 20:00 check only, the one after the 19:30 Operations run, its only scheduled run in those bands; FLOOR: none). after_role: a check launches only once an Operations run launched since the previous check has finished done and none is going (conductor.md "each after an Operations run", the cheaper reading: no finished Operations run by slot_late_s = the check is missed; Operations not enabled = an alarm and no checks). His message is not a Dispatcher trigger: session mode is the BENCH seat window itself when the owner speaks. His presence is not one either. seat/clone are the builder's defaults of 2026-10-27: confirm before enabling. model opus per infrastructure/agents/Agent_Policy.md, the one ladder (review T, F7).

roles.name: Arbiter
roles.trigger: feature claims done (batched: each clock batch runs only when a done claim is pending)
roles.off_switch: enabled false here, or the file D:\ClaudeWork\rimmandrake\arbiter\ARBITER_OFF
roles._pre_launch_why: review AA brief AA7: role_launch runs this in the Arbiter's unit before claude; it writes tiers.json, judge_list.json and bounces.json, and a non-zero exit (UNMEASURED: no ledger, no close_evidence key, a torn line) means claude never starts
roles._caps_why: measured run floor 35-53k tokens; a batch runs judge helpers, so 100,000; daily 250,000 = 2 batches x 1.25; RED one batch (17:00, 'Arbiter batches daily', v3 §3) at 75,000, never below 60,000
roles._why: verdicts advisory: blocks nothing, logs D:\ClaudeWork\rimmandrake\arbiter\verdicts.jsonl beside the interim GPT reviewer (sim findings 3-4: a binding Arbiter on today's quotas mostly defers work; its false-reject rate is unmeasured, RIMFLOW_ARBITER_MEASURE_FALSE_REJECTS). binding = owner's switch after >= 1 week advisory and a MEASURED false-reject rate on >= 30 verdicts. slot_when done_claims (DISPATCHER_BUILD_WEEKDAY_AND_EVENT_TRIGGERS): a batch launches only when a done claim (a `rimflow implemented` or `close` event) landed since the previous batch's launch; else the slot is a hold, no run. The batches stay at the clock (arbiter.md: batched into its 11:00/17:00 runs). helpers_max 2 (sim finding 5) is read by the instructions and the slot allocator's owner, not by role_launch.py. seat/clone/model are the builder's defaults of 2026-10-27 (model opus per rimflow_v3_roles.html): confirm before enabling.

roles.name: Auditor
roles.trigger: daily (Monday run carries the weekly pass)
roles.off_switch: enabled false here, or the file D:\ClaudeWork\rimmandrake\auditor\AUDITOR_OFF
roles._caps_why: measured run floor 35-53k tokens; a run drives re-check helpers, so 100,000 like the Arbiter; daily 125,000 = one run x 1.25; RED 75,000, never below 60,000
roles._why: RIMFLOW_AUDITOR_RETHINK_DAILY_CAP (sim finding 8): no count cap on investigations; coverage comes from the no-AI pre-screen of every close (AUDITOR_BUILD_PRESCREEN_CLOSES_NO_AI, owed before enabling) and value from repeat-error rules, so the role is NOT paused in RED (the old throttle_order paused it second and left ~4 audits a week); FLOOR stops it like every role. 13:00 = after the Arbiter's 11:00 batch. weekly_plan_weekday Mon: role_launch.py marks Monday's run mode weekly = the weekly pass (lessons to skills, pre-screen weights, codebase health, adversarial reviews). Token-blind: reads digest_blind.md. helpers_max 2 re-checkers (sim finding 5's judge count), read by the instructions, not by role_launch.py. seat/clone/model are the builder's defaults of 2026-10-27: confirm before enabling.

roles.name: Operations
roles._token_aware_why: the only AI that analyses burn (owner 2026-10-27): only its launch message carries the band, runway, budget and caps; every other role is token-blind and is told none of it (review T, F1)
roles._daily_cap_why: 2026-10-27 BENCH (delegated: role caps): 100,000 economy + 80,000 evening + one 80,000 alarm run + headroom, so one alarm a day still fits after the scheduled runs are reserved (review X)
roles.off_switch: enabled false here, or the file D:\ClaudeWork\rimmandrake\ops_watch\OPERATIONS_OFF
roles._why: role_launch.py runs runs_local (07:30 is the economy pass, economy_token_cap, and carries the morning running check: a band without the economy pass skips the whole 07:30 slot, the cheaper reading, operations.md) and once per OPEN ops_watch alarm crossing (alarm_runs): an alarm that clears runs again when it re-crosses, alarms open at first enable run once, one alarm run covers every unseen open alarm, alarm runs at least alarm_run_gap_s apart (review W, W1). daily 200,000 = 80,000 x 2 runs x 1.25; economy pass 100,000 (so it plus the evening run fit the day); bands as operations.md (quick = no economy pass; quick_one = one running check, no economy pass, no alarm runs). seat/clone are the builder's defaults of 2026-10-27: confirm before enabling. model opus per infrastructure/agents/Agent_Policy.md, the one ladder (review T, F7).

roles.name: Producer
roles.trigger: daily list, weekly plan (Wednesday run), replan on a forecast miss or failed plan step
roles.off_switch: enabled false here, or the file D:\ClaudeWork\rimmandrake\producer\PRODUCER_OFF
roles._caps_why: measured run floor 35-53k tokens; the Wednesday run carries the weekly plan, so 100,000; daily 125,000 = one 100,000 run x 1.25 (the coordinator's value, 2026-10-27): so an event run goes only on a day the 09:00 run has not spent the cap (it is refused with one cap alarm otherwise, and its events wait for the next run, which reads them); RED 75,000, never below 60,000
roles._why: takes goals from the Conductor (owner 2026-10-27), works alone. 09:00 after_role Operations: the run reads the 07:30 economy pass (in AMBER/RED, whose bands skip the 07:30 slot, after_ready follows the previous 19:30 run instead: review T, F4) so a replan request is picked up the same day; the cut list reaches the owner through the Conductor's 20:00 check or his session. weekly_plan_weekday Wed: role_launch.py runs that day's 09:00 as mode weekly (the prompt says weekly plan); RED slots weekly = the Wednesday run and event runs only (v3 §3 'Producer weekly'). event_runs (DISPATCHER_BUILD_WEEKDAY_AND_EVENT_TRIGGERS): one run a day outside the clock when, since the last launch, a plan step failed (a verify fail or a block on an OPEN item that is on the plan: plan_scope raised = `rimflow raise`d, row = a V1 milestone row; the ledger has no other plan marker) or Operations wrote a replan request (a note on ledger_item whose text starts REPLAN REQUEST; operations.md must name this prefix, owed to its doc owner). Further events that day wait for the next run, which reads them. seat/clone/model are the builder's defaults of 2026-10-27 (model opus per rimflow_v3_roles.html): confirm before enabling.

roles.name: Innovator
roles.off_switch: enabled false here, or the file D:\ClaudeWork\rimmandrake\innovator\INNOVATOR_OFF
roles._caps_why: measured run floor 35-53k tokens; a run drives experiment helpers, so 100,000; one run a day at most, daily 125,000 = 1.25 runs; RED/FLOOR run nothing
roles._why: process experiments 2x/week (Tue, Fri, mode run) and the design review weekly (Sun, mode weekly via weekly_plan_weekday), as v3 §2 and the responsibilities doc. Sunday puts the design letter before the Producer's Wednesday plan. Paused first (v3 §3): AMBER keeps only the Sunday design review, RED and FLOOR none. Token-blind: reads digest_blind.md. helpers_max 2 experiment helpers, read by the instructions. seat/clone/model are the builder's defaults of 2026-10-27: confirm before enabling.

account_pick._doc: account_pick.py (owner 2026-10-27 [O]: "Dispatch should be able to recognize that the system should switch to a new account before new work is released (when appropriate)"). Before a role launch, a ring or a recover the Dispatcher applies this rule to ops_watch status.json accounts.<label>.*: KEEP / SWITCH / UNMEASURED, noted on ledger_item when it changes. act recommend [A]: a SWITCH holds the kinds in hold and alarms the target; nothing runs claude-account (one account per machine, closes every window, machine DISARMED). Unmeasured current account: keep and alarm, never guess [O]. Lent accounts are the allocator's lent_rules data (<= 50% of his week early, never under the 10% floor near reset, off-limits dates [O]) judged by slot_allocator.lent_allowance; a lent account is a target only when no owned one is fit [O standing ruling]. Thresholds [A]: switch_when 0.8 = under the RED/AMBER line where the bands already shrink work; target 1.2 / 20% = a target that would not itself be switched away from within the day; lent_min_draw_pct 10 = not worth closing every window for less. rank soonest_reset [A]: use-it-or-lose-it.
